## ClinVar variants for BRCA1 and their pathogenic counts

**Query:** `BRCA1[gene] AND "Homo sapiens"[Organism]` against NCBI ClinVar (E-utilities `esearch`/`esummary`), retrieved **2026‑10‑24 UTC**.

### Bottom line
| Measure | Count | % of BRCA1 records |
|---|---|---|
| **Total human BRCA1-linked ClinVar variant records** | **16,106** | 100% |
| **Classified strictly “Pathogenic”** | **4,154** | 25.8% |
| “Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic” (combined label) | 229 | 1.4% |
| “Likely pathogenic” | 349 | 2.2% |
| **Pathogenic-inclusive (Pathogenic + Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic + Likely pathogenic)** | **4,732** | 29.4% |

So, answering directly: **4,154 variants are classified as strictly “Pathogenic”; 4,732 are pathogenic or likely pathogenic when the combined and “Likely pathogenic” categories are included.**

### Full classification breakdown (all 16,106 records)
| ClinVar germline classification | n |
|---|---|
| Pathogenic | 4,154 |
| Conflicting classifications of pathogenicity | 2,926 |
| Likely benign | 2,921 |
| Uncertain significance | 2,612 |
| No classification provided (blank) | 2,022 |
| Benign | 742 |
| Likely pathogenic | 349 |
| Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic | 229 |
| Benign/Likely benign | 95 |
| not provided | 50 |
| Other/no-classification variants (“no classification for the single variant”, “VUS-mid”, “VUS-high”, “no classifications from unflagged records”) | 6 |

**Review status of the 4,154 strictly Pathogenic records:** reviewed by expert panel 2,243; criteria provided, single submitter 1,344; criteria provided, multiple submitters, no conflicts 343; no assertion criteria provided 224.

### Which variants
The complete enumerated lists were exported (one row per ClinVar record, with VCV accession, HGVS title, variant type, classification, review status, and last-evaluated date):

- `/workspace/brca1_clinvar/BRCA1_ClinVar_pathogenic_strict.tsv` — the 4,154 strictly pathogenic records
- `/workspace/brca1_clinvar/BRCA1_ClinVar_pathogenic_inclusive.tsv` — the 4,732 pathogenic/likely-pathogenic records
- `/workspace/brca1_clinvar/BRCA1_ClinVar_summary.json` — machine-readable counts and prove
